# BuiltTheme { #anylumino.astryx.BuiltTheme }

```python
BuiltTheme(name='neutral', *, css=None, tokens=None, components=None)
```

Create a JSON-safe descriptor for a precompiled Astryx theme.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default     |
|------------|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| name       | str                               | Astryx theme name used by the generated CSS ``data-astryx-theme`` selectors. This must match the ``name`` in the TypeScript theme passed to ``npx astryx theme build``.                            | `'neutral'` |
| css        | str \| os.PathLike\[str\] \| None | Generated theme CSS content or a path to the generated CSS file. Pass ``None`` for built themes whose CSS is already bundled by AnyLumino, such as the default neutral theme.                      | `None`      |
| tokens     | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None       | Optional resolved token map from the built theme object. Token names may include or omit the leading ``"--"``. The CSS is what styles widgets; tokens are retained for Astryx hooks and debugging. | `None`      |
| components | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None       | Optional built component override metadata from the Astryx theme object.                                                                                                                           | `None`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                  |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | JSON-safe precompiled theme descriptor that can be passed to :class:`Theme`, :class:`Widget`, or :meth:`Widget.apply_brand`. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Built theme descriptors set ``__built`` in the frontend so Astryx ``Theme``
does not perform runtime style injection. When ``css`` is supplied,
AnyLumino injects that generated CSS into the notebook page and reuses it
across widgets with the same content.
